Privacy & backups

FlowTrack sends no transaction data anywhere. There are no accounts, analytics, ads, trackers, or cloud sync. Records stay in this browser. An optional PIN encrypts the local ledger; without it, records are readable by anyone with access to the browser profile. A short PIN can still be guessed by someone who obtains the locked file. It does not protect an unlocked device, malicious extensions, or malware.

Clearing site data, private browsing, browser cleanup, or losing this device can erase your records. JSON backups and CSV exports are not protected by the PIN; keep them private. Save a recovery key before you forget the PIN. It can reset the PIN without deleting records. Anyone with that key can access your locked ledger; keep it separate and private. Without the PIN, a previously saved recovery key, or a separate JSON backup, we cannot recover the records. A locked copy needs its PIN or matching recovery key. A different browser or website address has a separate ledger. Your hosting provider may receive standard web request logs when the app loads.
